title: Democracy Is Not Silence Between Elections
gist: The author argues that allegations of Election Commission bias toward the BJP in India, including in voter eligibility processes, erode institutional trust beyond any single election. The excerpt is truncated.

insights.claim: Opposition parties and activists allege that India's Election Commission has favored the ruling BJP in elections and in processes determining who can vote.
insights.speaker: Nabeel Kolothumthodi
insights.so_what: Perceived erosion of electoral independence is a governance-risk theme for India.

insights.claim: The author argues that when citizens doubt whether independent institutions act impartially, the problem is larger than electoral competition and extends beyond any one party or election.
insights.speaker: Nabeel Kolothumthodi
insights.so_what: Institutional legitimacy deficits can feed political instability over time.
